By.description:
Who decides that a task follows an edge: `code`, a `model`, a `human`, or nobody while it is
`asleep` on a wait.

Decider.description: Who decides a step's outcome: a `code` action, a `model` run or a `human`.

Effect.description: What a step may change: `none`, `read`, `reversible` or `irreversible`.

GuardAllow.description: A workflow's or a step's `guard` table.

allow.description: Guard names, built-in or from `[guard]` in `factory.toml`.

Step.description: One step: who decides its outcome, what it may change, and where each outcome leads.

action.description: The built-in action a code step runs: `open-pr`, `open-issue` or `run`.

agent.description: The agent that runs a model step.

approves.description: The irreversible steps a human step approves.

autonomous.description: Why an irreversible step may run without a person's approval.

by.description: Who decides an outcome's edge, where it differs from the step's decider.

guard.description: The guarded calls an irreversible step may make while it is approved or autonomous.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the workflow; `done` and `stop` are reserved.

next.description: Each outcome and the step it leads to, or `done` or `stop`.

options.description: The answers a person picks from at a human step.

prompt.description: What a model step tells its agent.

run.description: The command a `run` action runs with `sh -c`.

timeout.description:
How long one turn of a model step, or a `run` action's command, may run before Priory ends
it.

description:
`workflows/<name>.toml` or `.yaml`: the typed steps a task goes through. The file name is the
workflow's name.

band.description: The band of its tasks when neither their request nor their trigger sets one.

guard.description: The guarded calls every step of the workflow may make with no approval.

max_prs.description:
The most pull requests a task's stack may hold: `open-pr` refuses a longer one. No cap
when unset.

reopen.description:
The model step a done task goes back to when its open pull request gets feedback; by
default, the step that opened the pull request.

start.description: The id of the first step.

title: workflow
